Consumer Price Index - July 2026

Transmission of material in this release is embargoed until 8:30 a.m. (ET) August 12, 2026.

The Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (CPI-U) increased 0.2 percent in July on a seasonally adjusted basis. Over the last 12 months, the all items index increased 2.7 percent before seasonal adjustment.

The index for all items less food and energy rose 0.3 percent in July. The all items less food and energy index rose 3.1 percent over the last 12 months.
